symptom: PC1 cannot communicate with PC2 although both are connected to the same switch.
topology_note: PC1 is connected to SW1 Fa0/1 and PC2 to Fa0/2. Both should be in VLAN 10.
show_outputs: show vlan brief: VLAN 10 SALES active; VLAN 20 HR active. show interfaces fa0/1 switchport: Access Mode VLAN 20.
expected_fault: PC1 access port is assigned to the wrong VLAN.
expected_fix: Assign Fa0/1 to VLAN 10 and verify connectivity.

symptom: A PC connected to a newly configured department switch port cannot reach other department PCs.
topology_note: PC is connected to SW1 Fa0/10 and should belong to VLAN 30.
show_outputs: show vlan brief: VLAN 10 SALES active; VLAN 20 HR active; VLAN 30 is absent.
expected_fault: Required VLAN is missing from the switch.
expected_fix: Create VLAN 30 and assign the correct access port.

symptom: Users in VLAN 30 cannot communicate across two switches.
topology_note: PC1 is on SW1 and PC2 is on SW2. VLAN 30 must cross the inter-switch link.
show_outputs: show interfaces trunk: allowed VLANs 10,20. VLAN 30 is not listed.
expected_fault: Trunk does not allow VLAN 30.
expected_fix: Allow VLAN 30 on the trunk and verify VLAN propagation.

symptom: Devices on two switches have intermittent or failed communication after trunk configuration.
topology_note: SW1 and SW2 are connected by a trunk. Both sides use different native VLANs.
show_outputs: show interfaces trunk: SW1 native VLAN 99; SW2 native VLAN 1.
expected_fault: Native VLAN mismatch exists on the trunk.
expected_fix: Configure the same native VLAN on both trunk ends and verify.

symptom: PC receives an IP address but cannot reach networks outside its local subnet.
topology_note: PC address is 192.168.10.20/24. Router gateway should be 192.168.10.1.
show_outputs: ipconfig: IPv4 192.168.10.20; Mask 255.255.255.0; Default Gateway 192.168.20.1.
expected_fault: Default gateway does not belong to the PC subnet.
expected_fix: Change the PC default gateway to 192.168.10.1.

symptom: Multiple PCs cannot reach remote networks and cannot ping their router gateway.
topology_note: PCs connect to R1 G0/0.
show_outputs: show ip interface brief: GigabitEthernet0/0 192.168.10.1 administratively down/down.
expected_fault: Gateway interface is administratively down.
expected_fix: Enable G0/0 with no shutdown and verify interface status.

symptom: A PC reports an IP conflict and network access is unstable.
topology_note: PC1 and another device are configured in the same subnet.
show_outputs: show arp: 192.168.10.1 appears with changing MAC addresses; PC configuration uses 192.168.10.1.
expected_fault: PC has an IP conflict with the default gateway.
expected_fix: Assign the PC a unique IP address outside the gateway address.

symptom: PC can reach some local devices but cannot reach its default gateway.
topology_note: PC should be in 192.168.10.0/24.
show_outputs: ipconfig: IPv4 192.168.10.20; Mask 255.255.0.0; Gateway 192.168.10.1. Network is configured for /24.
expected_fault: Incorrect subnet mask causes incorrect local network determination.
expected_fix: Correct the subnet mask to 255.255.255.0 and retest.

symptom: PC automatically receives a 169.254.x.x address instead of a lab address.
topology_note: PC is connected to VLAN 10 and should receive an address from the R1 DHCP pool.
show_outputs: ipconfig: IPv4 169.254.12.8; DHCP Enabled Yes. show ip dhcp pool: no pool for VLAN 10.
expected_fault: DHCP pool for the client network is missing.
expected_fix: Create/configure the correct DHCP pool for VLAN 10.

symptom: Only some DHCP clients receive addresses and new clients fail to obtain an IP.
topology_note: R1 provides DHCP for 192.168.20.0/24.
show_outputs: show running-config: ip dhcp excluded-address 192.168.20.1 192.168.20.254. show ip dhcp pool: 0 addresses available.
expected_fault: DHCP excluded-address configuration excludes the entire address pool.
expected_fix: Reduce the excluded range so usable addresses remain in the pool.

symptom: Clients in VLAN 20 cannot obtain DHCP addresses from the central DHCP server.
topology_note: Clients are on SW1 VLAN 20; DHCP server is on another subnet.
show_outputs: show running-config interface vlan 20: no ip helper-address configured.
expected_fault: DHCP relay/helper address is missing.
expected_fix: Configure the DHCP server address with ip helper-address.

symptom: PC receives an IP address but cannot reach the router after DHCP assignment.
topology_note: DHCP server should provide gateway 192.168.30.1.
show_outputs: ipconfig: IPv4 192.168.30.25; Mask 255.255.255.0; Gateway 192.168.30.254. show ip dhcp pool: network 192.168.30.0/24.
expected_fault: DHCP pool provides the wrong default gateway.
expected_fix: Correct the default-router value in the DHCP pool.

symptom: PC can ping a web server by IP address but cannot access it using its hostname.
topology_note: PC uses DNS server 192.168.50.10.
show_outputs: ipconfig: DNS Servers 192.168.60.10. nslookup server.example.local: request timed out.
expected_fault: PC is configured with the wrong DNS server.
expected_fix: Configure the correct DNS server address and retest name resolution.

symptom: All clients report DNS resolution failures.
topology_note: DNS server is located on the internal server network.
show_outputs: ping 192.168.50.10: success. nslookup: Server failed to respond. show interfaces g0/1: server interface up/up.
expected_fault: DNS service is unavailable even though the server is reachable.
expected_fix: Check/restart the DNS service on the server and verify DNS records.

symptom: Clients can reach the DNS server but DNS queries from the client subnet fail.
topology_note: DNS server is 192.168.50.10 and clients are 192.168.10.0/24.
show_outputs: show access-lists: deny udp 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 host 192.168.50.10 eq 53.
expected_fault: ACL blocks DNS queries from the client subnet.
expected_fix: Permit DNS traffic to the DNS server and verify ACL order.

symptom: Ping to the server IP succeeds but the application using the server name fails.
topology_note: Client has network connectivity to the server.
show_outputs: nslookup app.example.local: Non-existent domain. DNS server responds successfully.
expected_fault: Required DNS record is missing.
expected_fix: Add/correct the DNS record and verify name resolution.

symptom: PC can reach its local gateway but cannot reach a remote network.
topology_note: R1 connects 192.168.10.0/24 to a remote 192.168.30.0/24 network.
show_outputs: show ip route: no route for 192.168.30.0/24.
expected_fault: Required route to the remote network is missing.
expected_fix: Add the correct static/dynamic route and verify the routing table.

symptom: Traffic to a remote network is sent to the wrong next hop.
topology_note: R1 has two possible paths to the destination.
show_outputs: show ip route 10.10.20.0: Routing entry points to 10.10.30.2, but correct next hop is 10.10.30.1.
expected_fault: Static route has an incorrect next-hop address.
expected_fix: Correct the next-hop and verify reachability.

symptom: OSPF neighbors are up but a remote LAN is not reachable.
topology_note: R1 and R2 form an OSPF adjacency; R1 owns 192.168.40.0/24.
show_outputs: show ip ospf neighbor: FULL. show ip route ospf: no 192.168.40.0/24 on R2.
expected_fault: The LAN is not being advertised into OSPF.
expected_fix: Advertise the missing network in OSPF and verify the route.

symptom: Internet-bound traffic fails while internal routes work.
topology_note: R1 connects the internal network to an ISP router.
show_outputs: show ip route: internal routes present; no 0.0.0.0/0 entry.
expected_fault: Default route is missing.
expected_fix: Configure the correct default route toward the ISP.

symptom: Users cannot access the web server after an ACL was deployed.
topology_note: Clients use 192.168.10.0/24 and web server is 192.168.50.20.
show_outputs: show access-lists: deny ip 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 host 192.168.50.20.
expected_fault: ACL explicitly denies required client-to-server traffic.
expected_fix: Modify ACL rules to permit the required web traffic.

symptom: A security ACL exists but intended traffic is not being filtered.
topology_note: Traffic enters R1 through G0/1.
show_outputs: show running-config interface g0/1: no ip access-group command. show access-lists: ACL 110 configured.
expected_fault: ACL is configured but not applied to the intended interface.
expected_fix: Apply the correct ACL in the required direction.

symptom: Allowed users are still unable to reach the application after an ACL change.
topology_note: Application is on 192.168.60.10; clients are 192.168.10.0/24.
show_outputs: show running-config interface g0/0: ip access-group 120 out. Traffic from clients enters through G0/0.
expected_fault: ACL direction is incorrect for the intended filtering point.
expected_fix: Apply the ACL in the correct direction/interface and retest.

symptom: One permitted host can reach a server but all other required hosts cannot.
topology_note: ACL should permit 192.168.10.0/24 to the application server.
show_outputs: show access-lists: permit ip host 192.168.10.10 host 192.168.60.10; implicit deny at end.
expected_fault: Implicit deny blocks the remaining required clients.
expected_fix: Add the required permit rule before the implicit deny.

symptom: Internal users can reach the router but cannot access the external network.
topology_note: Inside network is 192.168.10.0/24 and ISP is connected to R1.
show_outputs: show ip nat translations: empty. show ip nat statistics: active translations 0.
expected_fault: NAT overload is not translating inside addresses.
expected_fix: Configure the required NAT overload/PAT rule.

symptom: NAT ACL is configured but inside addresses are not translated.
topology_note: R1 has G0/0 as inside and G0/1 toward ISP.
show_outputs: show running-config: ip nat inside source list 1 interface g0/1 overload. show ip interface g0/0: no ip nat inside.
expected_fault: Inside interface is not marked for NAT.
expected_fix: Configure ip nat inside on the internal interface.

symptom: Clients cannot access the Internet after a router interface change.
topology_note: R1 G0/0 connects LAN and G0/1 connects ISP.
show_outputs: show running-config interface g0/1: ip nat inside. show running-config interface g0/0: ip nat inside.
expected_fault: Outside interface is incorrectly marked as inside.
expected_fix: Configure the ISP-facing interface as ip nat outside.

symptom: Only some internal clients receive Internet access through NAT.
topology_note: NAT overload uses ACL 1 to select inside addresses.
show_outputs: show access-lists 1: permit 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.127. Clients also use 192.168.10.128/25.
expected_fault: NAT ACL does not include the second client subnet/range.
expected_fix: Correct the NAT ACL so all intended inside addresses are translated.

symptom: Wireless clients receive connectivity but are placed in the wrong network.
topology_note: SSID Guest should map to guest VLAN 30.
show_outputs: show vlan brief: VLAN 30 GUEST active. show wireless/SSID mapping: Guest -> VLAN 10.
expected_fault: SSID is mapped to the wrong VLAN.
expected_fix: Map the Guest SSID to VLAN 30 and verify client addressing.

symptom: Wireless clients associate with the AP but receive no IP address.
topology_note: Guest wireless clients should receive addresses from the VLAN 30 DHCP pool.
show_outputs: show wireless client: associated. show ip dhcp pool: VLAN 30 pool has no requests. show interfaces trunk: VLAN 30 not allowed.
expected_fault: Wireless VLAN is not carried across the trunk to the gateway/DHCP network.
expected_fix: Allow VLAN 30 on the trunk and verify DHCP.

symptom: A wireless client repeatedly fails WPA authentication.
topology_note: SSID is visible and the AP is reachable.
show_outputs: show wireless client: authentication failed. WLAN security: WPA2-PSK configured. Client password differs from configured key.
expected_fault: Client is using an incorrect wireless security key.
expected_fix: Use the correct WPA2-PSK and reconnect the client.

symptom: Guest Wi-Fi can reach an internal server, creating a security concern.
topology_note: Guest clients are in VLAN 30; internal server is 192.168.10.20.
show_outputs: show access-lists: no deny/guest-isolation rule for VLAN 30. show vlan brief: VLAN 30 GUEST active.
expected_fault: Guest isolation/ACL protection is missing, allowing internal access.
expected_fix: Implement guest isolation and deny guest-to-internal traffic while allowing required Internet access.
